title: Qaiji IR: An Eight-Layer Intermediate Representation Family for Hybrid Quantum-Classical Compilation
summary: Hybrid quantum-classical compilation relates ideal operations and measurement outcomes to control pulses and device instructions. Existing formats each describe part of this process, and their preservation checks are often specific to one tool rather than to a common intermediate representation (IR). I present Qaiji-IR, an eight-layer IR family organized by a five-axis semantic contract for data, semantics, lowering, runtime, and verification.
